articles.title: Usual October cheer could be missing after rout last month
articles.description: As investors approach October, the landscape is shaped by high crude oil prices, increasing bond yields, and continued foreign selling. Historically, October has favored positive market returns, yet recent downturns could challenge this pattern. With the earnings season on the horizon, corporate profitability, particularly within large-cap stocks, will be under scrutiny.
